screening_decisions.reason: Theoretical/conceptual paper discussing Health Belief Model and social learning theory. Not an RCT, no intervention, no screening population.
Editorial/commentary piece about NHS breast screening programme. Not an RCT, no intervention study.

RCT evaluating educational intervention for women calling about breast/ovarian cancer risk and genetic testing. Intervention includes personalized family history assessment. Reports knowledge, perceived risk (cognitive outcomes), and intention to obtain genetic testing (behavioral outcome related to screening decision). Genetic testing constitutes a screening procedure.
Historical/theoretical paper on Health Belief Model development. Not an RCT, no intervention.
Overview paper on concepts and methods for risk assessment and decision making. Not an RCT, no intervention study.

RCT comparing individualized breast cancer risk counseling to general health counseling. Intervention includes personalized risk communication (estimated objective lifetime risk). Reports risk comprehension (cognitive outcome - concordance between perceived and estimated risk). Population is women with family history considering screening/testing decisions.
Study protocol for the BRISC trial. No results reported. Protocols are excluded from systematic reviews.
Book chapter on assessing risk of bias in studies. Methodological content, not an RCT or intervention study.

RCT with tailored mammography interventions. However, intervention is tailored based on beliefs/stage of change, not personalized risk communication. No measures of informed decisions reported - only mammography status (behavioral outcome).

RCT evaluating personalized Colon Cancer Risk Counseling (CCRC) intervention. Intervention includes personalized risk communication based on family history. Reports screening adherence (behavioral outcome) and participant ratings of information usefulness. Population is first-degree relatives of colorectal cancer patients considering screening.
RCT with tailored intervention for mammography. Intervention targets perceived risk and barriers, but no clear personalized risk communication element. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Systematic review on determinants of screening uptake. Not an RCT, no primary intervention data.

RCT testing a risk appraisal questionnaire for coronary heart disease. While it involves personalized risk assessment, the primary outcome is cholesterol testing rates (behavioral). No measures of informed decisions reported.
Commentary/opinion piece on information about screening. Not an RCT, no intervention study.

RCT testing tailored print materials for colorectal cancer screening. Intervention is tailored but not personalized risk communication. No measures of informed decisions reported - only screening rates.

RCT evaluating mail and telephone intervention for breast health behaviors. Intervention includes counseling but no clear personalized risk communication element. No measures of informed decisions reported.

RCT comparing evidence-based risk information brochure with internet modules vs standard information leaflet for colorectal cancer screening. Intervention includes personalized risk communication. Primary outcome is 'informed choice' (comprising knowledge, attitude, and uptake). Reports knowledge (cognitive), attitude (affective), and screening uptake (behavioral).
Validation study of the Decisional Conflict Scale. Not an intervention RCT, no personalized risk communication.
Expert opinion paper on formats for conveying health risks. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
RCT testing Colorectal Cancer Risk Appraisal intervention. While it involves risk assessment, no measures of informed decisions reported - only compliance rates and intentions.
Protocol for a Cochrane Review. Not an RCT, no primary data.
Editorial about breast cancer screening review. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
RCT comparing web-based and tailored interventions for CRC screening. Cost-effectiveness analysis. No measures of informed decisions reported - only screening rates and costs.
RCT testing combined computer and lay health advisor intervention for mammography. Intervention is tailored but no clear personalized risk communication. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Not a proper RCT - only randomized for newsletter component. Observational study of women in surveillance program. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Paper exploring difficulties in risk communication. Not an RCT, no intervention study.

RCT comparing decision aid (Ottawa Personal Decision Guide) plus standard genetic counseling vs standard counseling alone for prenatal testing decisions. Prenatal testing is a screening procedure. Reports decisional conflict (measure of informed decision process) and self-esteem. Intervention supports informed decision making.

RCT comparing tailored print materials vs non-tailored materials for BRCA genetic testing decisions. Intervention includes personalized risk communication based on individual family history. Reports knowledge (cognitive outcome) and accuracy of perceived risk. Genetic testing is a screening procedure. Both knowledge and risk perception are critical components of informed decision making.

RCT testing social comparison risk factor feedback for colorectal cancer. Intervention includes tailored risk factor feedback but no measures of informed decisions reported - only perceived risk, intentions, and FOBT return.
RCT testing shared decision-making program for benign prostatic hyperplasia treatment decisions. This is about treatment decisions, not screening decisions.
RCT with tailored belief/information interventions for mammography. No measures of informed decisions reported - only mammography compliance and stage of adoption.
RCT testing individualized health education program for cervical cancer screening. Reports knowledge and Pap smear uptake. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Commentary on communicating risk to patients. Not an RCT, no intervention study.

RCT testing decision aid (interactive booklet and DVD with quantitative risk information) for bowel cancer screening among adults with low education. Reports informed choice (primary outcome), knowledge (cognitive), attitudes (affective), screening uptake (behavioral), and decisional conflict. Intervention includes personalized risk communication.
Telephone survey study on how framing affects screening decisions. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Commentary/opinion piece on cancer screening approach. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
RCT comparing tailored vs standardized mammography recommendation letters. Intervention is tailored but no measures of informed decisions reported - only mammography status.
Editorial on benefits and harms of mammography screening. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Systematic review and meta-analysis on emotional impact of screening. Not an RCT, no primary intervention data.
Review paper on screening for cardiovascular risk and informed choice. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Meta-analytic review of tailored print health behavior change interventions. Not an RCT, no primary data.
Cochrane review on decision aids. Not a primary RCT study.
RCT comparing methods for increasing FOBT compliance. Health education intervention. No measures of informed decisions reported - only compliance rates.
RCT testing breast cancer risk assessment (Gail model) plus education program. Reports BSE, CBE, and mammography adherence. No measures of informed decisions reported.
RCT with tailored belief/information interventions for mammography. No measures of informed decisions reported - only mammography compliance.
RCT comparing tailored vs nontailored weight-loss materials. Not about screening decisions.
Commentary on GRADE system for rating evidence quality. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Method paper presenting a model for estimating breast cancer probabilities. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Review of outcomes used in risk communication research. Not an RCT, no intervention study.

RCT comparing genetic risk counseling and group counseling vs control for breast cancer genetic testing decisions. Intervention includes personalized risk counseling. Reports interest in genetic testing (behavioral outcome related to screening decision) and beliefs about testing (cognitive outcome). Genetic testing is a screening procedure.
RCT testing risk-tailored messages for mammography. Reports mammography rates. No measures of informed decisions reported.
RCT comparing tailored vs generic interventions for colorectal cancer screening. Reports screening adherence. No measures of informed decisions reported.
RCT comparing in-person, telephone, and no counseling for mammography. Reports mammography adherence, knowledge, beliefs. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Theoretical paper on Elaboration Likelihood model of persuasion. Not an RCT, no intervention study.

RCT testing self-administered decision aid booklet with detailed absolute risk and benefit information for colorectal cancer screening. Reports informed choice (primary outcome), knowledge (cognitive), and screening decisions (behavioral). Intervention includes personalized risk communication.

Cluster RCT testing decision aid booklet for prenatal testing of fetal abnormalities. Reports informed choice (primary outcome), knowledge (cognitive), decisional conflict, and anxiety/depression (affective outcomes). Prenatal testing is a screening procedure. Intervention supports informed decision making.
RCT testing targeted and tailored interventions for colorectal cancer screening. Reports screening rates. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Book chapter on meta-analysis methods. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Editorial on breast cancer screening debate. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Systematic review updating evidence on breast cancer screening effectiveness. Not an RCT, no primary intervention data.
Commentary on ethics of cervical screening programme. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Commentary on acceptable risks in hazard management. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Theoretical framework paper on patient decision making. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
RCT testing individualized breast cancer risk counseling. Reports mammography use. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Theoretical paper on transtheoretical model of health behavior change. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
RCT testing interactive video for ischemic heart disease treatment decisions. This is about treatment decisions, not screening decisions.

RCT comparing education-only vs education-plus-counseling approaches for BRCA1 genetic testing decisions. Intervention includes personalized discussion of family cancer history and risk. Reports knowledge (cognitive), perceived risk, perceived benefits/limitations (cognitive/affective), and testing intentions (behavioral outcome related to screening decision). Genetic testing is a screening procedure.
Commentary with mathematical modeling on public health policy tensions. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Systematic review of measures used in informed decision making studies about cancer screening. Not an RCT, no primary intervention data.
Commentary on measuring informed choice in cancer screening. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Longitudinal before-and-after study (not an RCT) on educational intervention for breast cancer risk perception. No control group, no randomization.
Commentary on ethics of guidelines in general practice. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
Method paper on efficient literature searching for systematic reviews. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
RCT testing enhanced health risk appraisal with tailored behavior change messages. Reports behavior changes including cholesterol screening. No measures of informed decisions reported.
RCT testing breast cancer risk counseling intervention. Reports perceived risk, anxiety, and screening rates. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Content analysis of 58 mammography pamphlets. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
RCT testing tailored vs generic interventions for skin cancer risk reduction. Reports skin examination and sun protection behaviors. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Qualitative study using focus groups on shared decision-making competences. Not an RCT, no intervention study.
RCT testing tailored behavioral intervention for prostate cancer early detection. Reports adherence to early detection. No measures of informed decisions reported.
RCT testing personalized counseling and tailored materials for melanoma risk reduction. Reports skin examination and sunscreen use. No measures of informed decisions reported.
RCT testing tailored interactive computer intervention for colorectal cancer screening. Reports screening rates, knowledge, self-efficacy. No measures of informed decisions reported.
Validation study of the Satisfaction with Decision scale. Not an intervention RCT, no personalized risk communication.
